new: The start page shows only the cards: no story is started, built or fetched behind them until you pick one.
Enter VR or AR from the start page opens the headset's Stories screen, with the first story loading behind it.
Stories start faster on a second visit: a story's file is taken from this device and compiled once, with no trip to the network.
A release no longer downloads the whole app again: unchanged files are kept; every story's file is fetched two at a time, after the first story.
Still to try from v214 to v216: the limited menu and the staff unlock, Subtitles per headset, and the hands' turn.
